scripts.bundle: pnpm assets:validate && pnpm client:build && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist/wrangler
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm assets:validate && pnpm art:validate && pnpm audio:validate && pnpm content:validate && pnpm test:protocol:goldens && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm synth
scripts.content:validate: tsx scripts/validate-content.ts && tsx scripts/compile-content.ts --check && tsx scripts/compile-benchmark.ts --check
scripts.deploy: pnpm assets:validate && pnpm client:build && cdktn deploy --auto-approve && cdktn output --skip-synth --outputs-file dist/cdktn-outputs.json && node scripts/build-deploy-config.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply RUNS --remote --config .wrangler.deploy.json && wrangler deploy --config .wrangler.deploy.json
scripts.dev: pnpm assets:validate && pnpm client:build && wrangler d1 migrations apply RUNS --local && wrangler dev
scripts.dev:lab: pnpm assets:validate && node scripts/build-client.mjs --lab && wrangler dev --local
scripts.worker:build: pnpm assets:validate && pnpm client:build && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist/wrangler
scripts.art:export: tsx scripts/assets/export-native.ts && tsx scripts/assets/export-cast.ts && tsx scripts/assets/export-breakwater.ts && pnpm art:review
scripts.art:validate: tsx scripts/assets/review-studies.ts && tsx scripts/assets/export-native.ts --check && tsx scripts/assets/export-cast.ts --check && tsx scripts/assets/export-breakwater.ts --check
